senses.gloss: Maudgalya (“descendant of Mudgala”), one or more ṛshis. § 59 (Sarpasattra): I, 53, 2049 (among the sadasyas at the snake-sacrifice of Janamejaya).--§ 520 (Mudgala): III, 261, 15446, 15453, 15464 (C. Moº), 15472, 15477 (= Mudgala, q.v.).--§ 637 (Rājadh.): XII, 47, 1596 (among the ṛshis who surrounded Bhīshma on his arrowbed).--§ 767 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 137, 6265 (king Śatadyumna ascended to heaven by giving a golden mansion to M.).
maudgalya, adj.(?), said of a caste: XIII, 2571 (Vaidehikañ cāpi maudgalyaṃ).
